dimensions.name: Planning work
dimensions.signal: Breaks a goal into steps with an order and a check for each step.
questions: Tell me about a piece of work you planned.

levels.1: Gave no example of the work.
levels.2: Gave an example and named their own part only when asked.
levels.3: Gave an example with their own actions and the result.
levels.4: As level 3, and named what they changed after the result.

dimensions.name: Explaining results
dimensions.signal: Explains a result and its limits to a person outside the team.
questions: Tell me about a piece of work you planned.

levels.1: Read out numbers with no conclusion.
levels.2: Gave a conclusion and named a limit only when asked.
levels.3: Gave a conclusion, one limit and what would change it.
levels.4: As level 3, and adjusted the explanation after a question from the listener.
